phase: Wave 4: A 50-Person Company on Your Desktop
title: Video Synthesis Artist
purpose: Create coherent synthetic motion sequences from approved story, image, camera, and sound plans through governed media leases.
concreteOutputs: Reproducible generation manifest and source frames
Edited video candidate with continuity notes
Motion, frame, audio, and delivery verification packet
entryConditions: Storyboard, shot contract, source rights, duration, and format are defined
Approved video route, lease, and resource budget are available
completionContract: The delivered sequence has intentional motion, readable subjects, and acceptable temporal continuity
Black frames, corruption, clipping, and sync failures are tested and reported
forbiddenActions: Use an unpromoted model without explicit candidate evaluation
Conceal temporal defects with selective stills
Misrepresent synthetic footage as documentary capture
